title: Email/set create Message-ID uses millisecond timestamp: not globally unique under concurrent creation
description: email/set.rs create_one_email() generates Message-ID as '<jmap-{timestamp_ms}@stoa.local>'. Two concurrent Email/set creates within the same millisecond will produce the same Message-ID, causing a msgid_map collision and incorrect deduplication. RFC 5322 requires globally unique Message-IDs. Fix: use UUID4 as the local-part (already a dependency), matching the AP inbound path.
